final: WITH counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY ordertune), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM counts), above_avg AS (SELECT cnt FROM counts WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_of_above_avg, AVG(cnt - (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_avg)) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
